# Test fixture

`lua54.dll` is the unmodified Lua 5.4.8 library for Windows x64, as published by the LuaBinaries project
(<https://luabinaries.sourceforge.net>, file `lua-5.4.8_Win64_bin.zip`, MD5 of the zip `0baf094095efb66c1cad847da37f6451`).

Lua is free software under the MIT license: Copyright (C) 1994-2025 Lua.org, PUC-Rio.
Full text: <https://www.lua.org/license.html>

It is used only to test that analysis and the pool work the same on every operating system.
